threads.author: Freddy Arias
threads.summary: Parent and child records on the same job end up with different Job Statuses - the parent was cancelled while a line item stayed on Scheduled.
threads.note: Adjet has the root cause and is working the fix under COP-2068; nothing owed to Freddy right now.

threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Asks that a contact number be made mandatory for the Roche requestor and on-site person, because requests keep arriving without one and she has to chase Roche before she can schedule.
threads.note: Root cause confirmed - the Roche API validation requires created_by_name and created_by_email but not the phone number; 24% of the last 250 requests had no number at all. Blocked on a decision with Troy Lowry on whether Roche makes it mandatory at source before we enforce it.
